case: laser-beam versus ls-beam: geometry only (BLOCKED for yield, direction, time, camera)

blocked.reason: obdeect laser-beam emits primary beam photons; ls-beam emits light scattered from the beam (Rayleigh/aerosol). obdeect propagation has no scattering yet (plan step 6b: beta_s(355 nm) aerosol, single-scattering albedo and phase asymmetry missing), so scattered yield, direction, wavelength, time and camera p.e. cannot be compared.

mapping.geometry: laser (1000,0,0) m, theta 60, phi 180 (astronomical), telescope theta 30 phi 0, radius 12.5 m, FoV 15 deg, step 0.1 m (both)
mapping.spectrum: 355 nm (both; not used in the geometry check)
mapping.compared: FoV entry and exit printed by ls-beam: endpoint offsets to the primary extremes (one step) and perpendicular distance to the primary line (1 cm); emission altitudes inside the primary segment

physics_limits.endpoints: one step (0.1 m): primary sampling at the ends
physics_limits.off_line: 1 cm: ls-beam writes cm with float precision

limit_setting: Limits set before the first run.
